items.name: Vimol Kalia
items.text:
I completed my 45-day Cloud Computing training at TechCADD Mohali around 3 months ago. The training itself was completed, but I have been facing an issue regarding my training certificate.
I have contacted the team multiple times and requested the certificate, but unfortunately, I have not received any proper response or update so far. It has already been around 3 months since completing the training, and the certificate has still not been provided.
I would appreciate it if the management could look into this matter and provide a clear update regarding the certificate. I hope the issue will be resolved soon.
